pineapple_house.name: SpongeBert's Pineapple
pineapple_house.description: A two-story pineapple with a round door and a snail-sized mailbox.

pat_rock.name: Pat's Rock
pat_rock.description: A rock. Pat lives under it. There is a weathervane.

squidwerd_house.name: Squidwerd's Head House
squidwerd_house.description: A stone head with very judgemental eyebrows.

krusty_crab.name: The Krusty Crab
krusty_crab.description: The finest (only) lobster-trap restaurant in town.

treedome.name: Sandy's Treedome
treedome.description: An air-filled glass dome with an oak tree inside. Bring a water helmet.

jellyfish_fields.name: Jellyfish Fields
jellyfish_fields.description: Rolling green hills full of buzzing pink jellyfish.

goo_lagoon.name: Goo Lagoon
goo_lagoon.description: Bikini Bottom's favourite beach. Mind the goo.

chum_bucket.name: The Chum Bucket
chum_bucket.description: A gloomy metal bucket of a restaurant across the street. Usually empty.

boating_school.name: Boating School
boating_school.description: Where everyone learns to drive a boat. Some take longer than others.

sunset_arms.name: Sunset Arms
sunset_arms.description: Grandpa's old brick boarding house, full of strange tenants and stranger pets.

arnald_room.name: Arnald's Room
arnald_room.description: An attic bedroom with a giant skylight and a couch that folds out of the wall.

ps118.name: P.S. 118
ps118.description: Hillwood's public school. The steps are prime territory for being told to move it.

classroom.name: Fourth Grade Classroom
classroom.description: Chalkboard, cubbies, and a clock that never moves fast enough.

gerold_field.name: Gerold Field
gerold_field.description: A vacant lot turned baseball diamond, surrounded by chain-link and brick.

big_bobs.name: Big Bob's Beepers
big_bobs.description: Helga's dad's store. Home of the beeper. Beepers are the future.

slausens.name: Slausen's Ice Cream
slausens.description: The neighborhood ice cream parlor. Checkered floor, triple scoops.

green_meats.name: Green Meats
green_meats.description: Mr. Green's butcher shop. Finest cuts in Hillwood.

hillwood_pier.name: Hillwood Pier
hillwood_pier.description: Old wooden docks on the river with the whole city skyline across the water.

rooftop.name: Rooftop at Dusk
rooftop.description: Where everybody in Hillwood goes to think about life.
